name: verified
description: Verified - Firebase #BuildHybridAI. Root scripts for the backend + emulators.

scripts.emulators: npm run build && infra/fb.sh emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,hosting
scripts.emulators:persist: npm run build && infra/fb.sh emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,hosting --import .emulator-data --export-on-exit .emulator-data
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: infra/fb.sh emulators:exec --project demo-verified-rules --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && infra/fb.sh emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node functions/scripts/seed.mjs && node functions/scripts/feed.mjs && node functions/scripts/ladder-check.mjs && node functions/scripts/delete-check.mjs"
